meta.source: National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), product and UPI ecosystem statistics, captured by the local Data Bank
meta.vintageNote: NPCI publishes no revision date for its statistics and edits past rows in place without notice; these are its tables as the Data Bank captured them on the archiveCapturedDate.
meta.revisionPolicy: NPCI edits past rows in place without notice (it revised April 2023's UPI volume, and NETC's February and March 2026 in October 2026). Each capture is the table as NPCI then showed it; the Data Bank keeps every capture.
meta.coverage: Recurring debits through NACH each month since July 2013 (EMIs, SIPs, insurance premiums, bills paid by mandate): presented, returned unpaid and successful, number and value; with NPCI's total of credit and debit together
meta.note: NPCI's NACH debit table, counts and rupees as printed. The 156-character file format ran beside the 306-character one from April 2015 to July 2019. NPCI's 'Total volume' row for credit and debit together is printed on the debit tab and kept as a line of its own. A debit 'returned' is one the payer's bank sent back unpaid (in most cases for want of balance).
